pages.title: Carve Restrictions
pages.text: Place a weapon in the Restriction Table, select restrictions, and solve the Ling Shu Abacus. Only success writes the selected layers into the weapon.$(br2)The item tooltip shows its tier and current restriction progress. Failure grants no selected layers and can cause backlash.

pages.title: A Cycle of 72
pages.text: Each artifact tier has a 72-layer cycle. At a full cycle, use Evolve in the Restriction Table to attempt advancement.$(br2)Weapon evolution starts a tribulation rather than advancing unconditionally. After success, existing restrictions merge into the weapon, the current cycle resets, and the next tier begins.
